files.description: 159-page PDF containing OneTouch EMR Version 3 FHIR R4 API documentation covering 18 US Core resource types with field-level attributes, search parameters, worked examples, FHIR Bulk Data Access API, OAuth 2.0 security, and a dedicated EHI Export section (pp. 153-157) documenting the single-patient and all-patient export workflow that produces ZIP files with NDJSON FHIR resources. The EHI export leverages FHIR Bulk Data and exports the same 18 US Core resource types as the (g)(10) API.
